page.content:
An Oathgate is an immense fabrial capable of transporting anyone to Urithiru. The exact nature of Oathgthumbates is unknown and they are widely thought to be a myth by the people of Roshar.

page.overview:
What is Oathgate?

An Oathgate is an immense fabrial capable of transporting anyone to Urithiru. The exact nature of Oathgthumbates is unknown and they are widely thought to be a myth by the people of Roshar.
